blocks.content: Search engines like Google use the <title> tag to understand the topic of a page. This helps them display relevant websites to users.
That's why it's important to follow best practices while writing the title.

items: Use a single <title> element per webpage.
Write a title that accurately reflects the page's content.
Use a concise yet descriptive title.

blocks.content: The first title provides more context and is likely to perform better in search results.
